summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its Q1 2026 earnings and disclosed execution of binding agreements to acquire Halo Privacy and HavenX. The acquisitions add approximately $7 million in annualized contracted revenues at ~55% gross margin. Combined with existing ~$15–$17 million contracted backlog, total one-year revenue visibility reaches ~$21–$22 million. No per-share price, premium, or advisor details are provided. The deals are expected to close as part of a turnaround strategy. Watch for closing conditions and integration progress; the risk-arb angle hinges on accretive margin expansion and revenue synergies.
